headline: United's hubs are running normally; a delay program is slowing Seattle arrivals.

items.text: The seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better, and no ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any of them.
The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Seattle (SEA) until 9:59 PM PT. Flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes.

The FAA's plan lists four possible programs, none in effect now: tomorrow after 1:00 PM ET for Boston, tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET for New York LaGuardia (also JFK), tomorrow after 1:00 PM ET for a ground stop at Miami, and tomorrow after 9:00 AM PT for San Diego.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
